user_method: direct multi-step LightGBM with horizon as feature and CQR separately calibrated per horizon
evaluation: 2017 monthly rolling origins t, horizon1-24 target=t+h; final23origin hours lack some2018labels and are excluded only from metrics, not prediction generation
split: 28day pre-month calibration. Fit point/quantile with all target times strictly before calibration start; scale on first65%calibration, all its target times before Cq start; per-horizon Cq targets strictly before target month. Train/calibrate once before monthly origin evaluation, never refit within evaluation month.
features: horizon; target calendar hour/weekday/month/weekend/federal observed holiday (known at t); origin load t,t-1,t-24,t-168; rolling24/168 inclusive t; seasonal anchor y(t+h-24) known at t; origin lag disagreement; air_temperature(t) past-forward-filled persistence, never target observed weather
point: nonnegative seasonal-anchor plus residual regressor; one pooled model across horizons
scale: absolute point residual model trained only first calibration65% with horizon and holiday feature; clipped min0.001
risk: same weights[0.7,0.15,0.1,0.05], per-horizon Cq rank refs on scale, origin lag disagreement and constant training building/usage residual prior; rho0.15 higher quantile risk threshold; CQR q on gate-retained Cq; max_relative_width1.0; alpha0.095 unchanged
confidence: per-horizon past completed-month out-of-sample risk-bin isotonic coverage; December2016warm-up for January; exclude any previous-month origin with target not yet observed before current month; existing99%empirical+1%risk and width/gate penalty. Display score not conditional probability.
baseline: load(t) persistence, metrics only; not a second model selection path
limitation: 2017previously studied for one-step; this is not never-seen blind test. Fixed single24step protocol with no candidate search or final retuning. UTC labels represent BDG2wall clock, not verified UTC timezone conversion.
